import asyncio,json,time,math,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import yaml,rclpy
from launch import LaunchService,LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import ExecuteProcess,RegisterEventHandler
from launch.event_handlers import OnProcessExit
from lifecycle_msgs.srv import ChangeState
from rcl_interfaces.srv import SetParameters
from rclpy.parameter import Parameter
from rclpy.qos import QoSProfile,QoSReliabilityPolicy,QoSDurabilityPolicy
from geometry_msgs.msg import TransformStamped
from nav_msgs.msg import OccupancyGrid
from tf2_msgs.msg import TFMessage
from rosgraph_msgs.msg import Clock
from probe_real_nav2_keepout import Observer

async def main():
    rclpy.init();node=Observer();samples={'baseline':[],'candidate':[]}
    phase=['warmup'];exit_codes=[]
    def observe(msg,info):
        node.global_grid=msg
        if phase[0] in samples:
            samples[phase[0]].append({'ros_ns':msg.header.stamp.sec*1000000000+msg.header.stamp.nanosec,
                'dds_ns':int(info.source_timestamp),'received_wall_ns':time.time_ns(),
                'geometry':hashlib.sha256(bytes((int(v)+256)%256 for v in msg.data)).hexdigest(),
                'width':msg.info.width,'height':msg.info.height,'frame':msg.header.frame_id})
    sub=next(s for s in node.subscriptions if s.topic_name=='/global_costmap/costmap')
    sub.callback=observe
    q=QoSProfile(depth=1,reliability=QoSReliabilityPolicy.RELIABLE,
                 durability=QoSDurabilityPolicy.TRANSIENT_LOCAL)
    maps=node.create_publisher(OccupancyGrid,'/map',q)
    tf=node.create_publisher(TFMessage,'/tf_static',q)
    clocks=node.create_publisher(Clock,'/clock',10)
    grid=OccupancyGrid();grid.header.frame_id='map';grid.header.stamp.sec=1
    grid.info.resolution=.1;grid.info.width=grid.info.height=20
    grid.info.origin.position.x=grid.info.origin.position.y=-1.
    grid.info.origin.orientation.w=1.;grid.data=[0]*400
    maps.publish(grid)
    transform=TransformStamped();transform.header.frame_id='map'
    transform.child_frame_id='base_link';transform.header.stamp.sec=1
    transform.transform.rotation.w=1.;tf.publish(TFMessage(transforms=[transform]))
    cfg={'/**':{'ros__parameters':{'use_sim_time':True,'global_frame':'map',
        'robot_base_frame':'base_link','update_frequency':2.,'publish_frequency':2.,
        'always_send_full_costmap':True,'rolling_window':False,'width':2,'height':2,
        'resolution':.1,'origin_x':-1.,'origin_y':-1.,'robot_radius':.1745,
        'plugins':['static_layer'],'static_layer':{'plugin':'nav2_costmap_2d::StaticLayer',
            'map_topic':'/map','map_subscribe_transient_local':True}}}}
    params=Path('/tmp/costmap_cadence.yaml');params.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(cfg))
    process=ExecuteProcess(cmd=['/opt/ros/jazzy/lib/nav2_costmap_2d/nav2_costmap_2d',
        '--ros-args','-r','__node:=global_costmap','-r','__ns:=/global_costmap',
        '--params-file',str(params)],name='owned_costmap_cadence_target',output='screen')
    launch=LaunchService();launch.include_launch_description(LaunchDescription([
        process,RegisterEventHandler(OnProcessExit(target_action=process,
            on_exit=lambda event,context:exit_codes.append(event.returncode) or []))]))
    task=asyncio.create_task(launch.run_async())
    start=time.monotonic();clock_anchor=[None];clock_base=[1000000000];last_ns=[0]
    def emit_clock():
        now=time.monotonic()
        ns=(1000000000+int((now-start)/.02)*20000000 if clock_anchor[0] is None
            else clock_base[0]+int((now-clock_anchor[0])/.5)*500000000)
        assert ns>=last_ns[0];last_ns[0]=ns
        msg=Clock();msg.clock.sec=ns//1000000000;msg.clock.nanosec=ns%1000000000
        clocks.publish(msg)
    async def until(pred,seconds):
        end=time.monotonic()+seconds
        while time.monotonic()<end:
            if task.done():raise RuntimeError('costmap process/launch terminated before measurements')
            emit_clock();rclpy.spin_once(node,timeout_sec=0.)
            if pred():return
            await asyncio.sleep(.01)
        raise RuntimeError('cadence probe stage timeout')
    lifecycle=node.create_client(ChangeState,'/global_costmap/global_costmap/change_state')
    settings=node.create_client(SetParameters,'/global_costmap/global_costmap/set_parameters')
    result={'ok':False,'scope':'Actual installed Nav2 costmap binary, synthetic static map/TF/clock; reused Observer node/subscription, no Gazebo/motor.','clock_quantum_s':.5,'update_frequency':2.,'publish_before':2.,'publish_after':4.}
    try:
        await until(lifecycle.service_is_ready,20)
        for transition in (1,3):
            req=ChangeState.Request();req.transition.id=transition
            future=lifecycle.call_async(req);await until(future.done,20)
            assert future.result().success,('lifecycle',transition)
        clock_base[0]=last_ns[0];clock_anchor[0]=time.monotonic()-.25
        phase[0]='baseline';await until(lambda:len(samples['baseline'])>=18,35)
        await until(settings.service_is_ready,5)
        req=SetParameters.Request();req.parameters=[Parameter('publish_frequency',value=4.).to_parameter_msg()]
        future=settings.call_async(req);await until(future.done,5)
        assert all(p.successful for p in future.result().results)
        phase[0]='candidate';await until(lambda:len(samples['candidate'])>=18,20)
        summaries={}
        for key,raw in samples.items():
            data=raw[2:];ros=[(b['ros_ns']-a['ros_ns'])*1e-9 for a,b in zip(data,data[1:])]
            dds=[(b['dds_ns']-a['dds_ns'])*1e-9 for a,b in zip(data,data[1:])]
            assert len(ros)>=12 and all(x>0 for x in ros)
            summaries[key]={'count':len(data),'ros_gaps_s':ros,'dds_gaps_s':dds,
                'max_ros_gap_s':max(ros),'max_dds_gap_s':max(dds)}
        assert max(summaries['baseline']['ros_gaps_s'])>=1.
        assert max(summaries['candidate']['ros_gaps_s'])<=.500000001
        assert max(summaries['candidate']['dds_gaps_s'])<.9
        assert len({s['geometry'] for data in samples.values() for s in data})==1
        result.update(ok=True,summaries=summaries,samples=samples,
            nav2_version=subprocess.check_output(['dpkg-query','-W','ros-jazzy-nav2-costmap-2d'],text=True).strip())
    except Exception as exc:result['error']=repr(exc)
    finally:
        phase[0]='cleanup';launch.shutdown()
        try:await asyncio.wait_for(task,timeout=15)
        except Exception as exc:result['cleanup_error']=repr(exc);result['ok']=False
        result['target_exit_codes']=exit_codes
        if exit_codes!=[0]:result['ok']=False
        node.destroy_node();rclpy.shutdown()
        print('COSTMAP_CADENCE_RESULT '+json.dumps(result),flush=True)
    return 0 if result['ok'] else 1
raise SystemExit(asyncio.run(main()))
